evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen from 28766 ppm at 120 s to 13.8 ppm.
Ramp reached 749.7 °C against 749.6 °C setpoint with argon at 99.7 sccm against 100 sccm.
Initial growth-stage temperature overshoot to 759.7 °C accompanied by heater power reduction to 38.6%; subsequent readings show settling.
Growth is stable: 750.4 °C against 750 °C setpoint, heater power 44.7%, argon 100.6 sccm against 100 sccm, oxygen 2.4 ppm, status running.
Pressure gauge is not installed; null pressure readings are expected, not a fault.

args.missing_evidence: Sample characterization is needed to determine whether the target material grew; tube pressure is not directly observable with the installed sensors.
